title: feat(plugin-auth): serve the platform-admin roster from Setup → Users (#28793)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94h2uDrWeXZQMBGzbYv71H1)_
Fixes #28793
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:设置 → 用户 列表工具栏多了一个「平台管理员」入口,点开就是一张当前持有平台管理员资格的人员名单;列表本身不加列。
- 为什么改:旧的 `role` 列移除后,列表上看不出谁是平台管理员;按裁决 C,用 last-admin guard 里现成的枚举器给出名单,每个人再用同一个判定 `hasPlatformAdminStanding` 逐个确认。
- 风险与回滚:只读入口,只对平台管理员本人开放,组织管理员一律 403;guard 的行为不变(枚举代码原地抽成共享读取器)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts`(枚举器抽出与导出,风险点在 `createStandingReader` 与 `standing` 参数),`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/platform-admin-roster.ts`(调用者资格二次确认),`packages/core/src/security/admin-standing-surface.ts`(台账钉)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/platform-admin-roster.pin.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全绿(名单与判定逐人一致、组织管理员被拒)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The enumerator is exported, not copied.** `last-admin-guard.ts`'s standing reads (`scan`, the ledger and Default Organization reads, `anchorOwnerTest`, `resolveAdminUserIds`) move, text unchanged, from inside `registerLastAdminGuard` into a module-level `createStandingReader(engine, maxScan)`. The guard destructures them from it, so its behaviour is unchanged. The new export `resolveAdminUserIds(engine, { standing, maxScan })` reads through the same reader: `standing: 'administrators'` (default) is the guard's population, and `'platform-admins'` skips the organization owner and admin half. An overflowing read on the roster path throws the guard's existing 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` read fault instead of a refusal worded for a write.
- **The route.** `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/list-platform-admins` (`auth-plugin.ts`, same family as `set-user-manager`): `gateAdmin` first, then `runPlatformAdminRoster` (`platform-admin-roster.ts`). The handler confirms the caller through `hasPlatformAdminStanding` as well, because the shared gate still honours the legacy `role` scalar as a fallback and the roster names platform operators. A non-holder gets the gate's own 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` body (`PLATFORM_ADMIN_REFUSAL_MESSAGES[403]`). It enumerates the candidates and keeps those the predicate confirms, then answers `{ count, admins: [{ id, name, email }], entries }`. No body is read: platform standing belongs to no organization, and the console adds `organizationId` to every auth action. Ledgered in `auth-route-ledger.ts`.
- **The Setup entry.** `sys_user.list_platform_admins`: one `list_toolbar` action posting to the route, `visible: 'current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true'` like the other platform-admin actions, `refreshAfter: false`, and a `resultDialog` drawing `entries` as a `code-list`. There is no `ai` block, because the action postdates the ADR-0011 identity-actions assessment and an unassessed action stays human-only. Translated in the four packs (zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES written by hand, regenerated with `check-i18n-bundles --write`).
- **The ledger pin.** `ADMIN_STANDING_PLATFORM_ENUMERATION` (`admin-standing-surface.ts`) names the enumerator and sorts every input of the administrator derivation into `candidateSources` (`sys_user_permission_set`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`) or `notCandidates`. The core test holds that classification to exactly the declared deriving tables and non-table inputs. plugin-auth's `platform-admin-roster.pin.test.ts` requires a sole-source fixture per candidate that the enumerator finds. A third source is red at one of the two until the enumerator reads it.
- **Route shape chosen:** the precedent is `set_user_manager` / `POST /admin/set-user-manager`: a `type: 'api'` sys_user action to an ObjectStack `/admin/*` mount behind `gateAdmin`. It is POST because `ActionSchema.method` has no GET member.

Forced test edits, each a list a new mount must join:
- `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the hand-written objectstack-mount list gains the route.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-route-nonadmin-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`: the `/admin/` sweep's expectation table gains the route (`objectstack-gate` bucket, empty body), because a derived route with no entry fails the suite by name.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-platform-admin-standing.dogfood.test.ts`: the platform-admin `/admin/` sweep's `ADMITTED` list and payload table gain the route. Before that, the sweep failed by name on the new mount: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/list-platform-admins: expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []` (unclassified). The same file gains `C-28793`, which pins the booted stack's answer: the platform admin's own id is on the roster, the plain-member target is not, and `count` and `entries` agree with `admins`.

The widening (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`) is a new public route plus the new exports `resolveAdminUserIds` and `ADMIN_STANDING_PLATFORM_ENUMERATION`. Nothing an existing caller relied on changed, so the level stays `patch`.

## Tests

Package suites ran at head `6b5dd985` (origin/main merged once); the two named dogfood runs below are at `365488e5`. Every run went through `os-verify-lock`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 212 passed (212), Tests 3655 passed, 10 skipped (3665).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 109 passed (109), Tests 1507 passed (1507).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: Test Files 129 passed (129), Tests 2913 passed (2913).
- `typecheck` on the three packages: exit 0 (plugin-auth's test layer is held at its ledgered 88 errors and 23 signatures).
- Dogfood, run locally because the dogfood shards are skipped on PRs and in the merge queue (`packages/qa/dogfood`, built dists of plugin-auth, platform-objects and core at this head):
  - `pnpm exec vitest run test/admin-route-nonadmin-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 7 passed (7).
  - `pnpm exec vitest run test/admin-platform-admin-standing.dogfood.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 8 passed (8). Before this head's classification it was 1 failed (the unclassified-route assertion above).
  - `pnpm exec vitest run` over the other files that sweep `/admin/` routes, the auth route ledger, or `sys_user` actions and api-action doors: `route-ledger-live-mount-parity`, `discovery-auth-families`, `admin-ledger-decision-metadata`, `api-action-door-forward`, `mcp-system-object-action-exposure`, `mcp-oauth-api-action-forward`, `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces`, `admin-identity-audit-trail`, `admin-credential-lifecycle` (each `.dogfood.test.ts`). Run together with the standing file at `6b5dd985` (no runtime source differs from `365488e5`; only the standing test and the changeset changed): Test Files 1 failed | 9 passed (10), Tests 1 failed | 147 passed (148). The 9 files account for all 141 of their tests passing, and the 1 failure was the standing file's unclassified-route assertion, which is fixed at this head.
- New: `platform-admin-roster.pin.test.ts` (12 tests, real ObjectQL on better-sqlite3 with the real `hasPlatformAdminStanding`), `sys-user-platform-admin-roster-action.test.ts` (4), and 4 classification tests in `admin-standing-surface.test.ts`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. The caller check in `runPlatformAdminRoster` was replaced with `if (false)`. Four refusal cases went red, `expected 200 to be 403` (org owner, plain member, unverified owner address, unknown id).
2. The `standing === 'platform-admins' ? [] :` guard on the membership read was removed. `the platform-admin population leaves an organization owner out` went red. The roster agreement stayed green, because the predicate confirmation drops the org owner, which is the second layer working. The first attempt was refused by `ablation-replace` (the replacement was a substring of the anchor, so it did not land) and was redone with a distinct replacement.
3. The owner-email half was disabled (`emails.length < 0`). Five went red, including agreement (`expected [ 'usr_grant' ] to deeply equal [ 'usr_grant', 'usr_owner' ]`) and the sole-source `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` case.
4. `sys_member` was dropped from `notCandidates`. The core classification test went red (the declared list holds `sys_member`, the classified list does not).
5. Cross-package: a third candidate `sys_ablation_third_source` was added to `candidateSources`. Core was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` showed the marker present in 2 built files. The plugin-auth pin went red: `'sys_ablation_third_source' is a declared platform-admin candidate source with no fixture here: teach the enumerator …`. On restore core was rebuilt, and the preflight `--absent` showed the marker absent from all 14 built files with the tree clean.

6. Live stack: the predicate confirmation in `resolvePlatformAdminRoster` was made unreachable (`String(id) === 'ablation-28793-never' && …`), and plugin-auth was rebuilt. `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files. `admin-platform-admin-standing.dogfood.test.ts` went red on `C-28793` only (1 failed, 7 passed): `the roster omits the platform admin: {"success":true,"data":{"count":0,"admins":[],"entries":[]}}`. On restore plugin-auth was rebuilt, `--absent` showed the marker gone from all 20 built files, and the source blob was back to HEAD. A first attempt used a comment marker, which esbuild strips (the preflight reported it absent from dist), and `-t` skipped the identity control. Both were void readings and both were redone.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **A platform administrator reaches the roster from Setup → Users in one step:** the toolbar entry opens the result dialog.
- **The ui renders it with no ui change (measured).** A scratch render of the console's `ActionResultDialog` with this action's `resultDialog` and the route's answer drew one list row per entry, with the code text equal to `entries` (`ui/` vitest, 1 passed; the file was deleted after the run). The rows are plain text with per-row copy and Copy all. They are not links to the user records, which would be a ui follow-up if wanted.
- **The roster agrees user by user with `hasPlatformAdminStanding`.** The fixture holds a Default Organization grant, a verified owner address, an unverified one, an expired grant, another organization's grant held by that organization's owner, and a plain member.
- **A non-platform-admin caller is refused**, an organization owner included, with the gate's 403 body and no data.
- **The Users list page's request count is unchanged:** no `sys_user` field and no read hook are added, and the list columns stay pinned in `sys-user-list-columns.test.ts`.
- Open PR overlap: #29387 also edits `packages/core/src/security/index.ts` (an export list), so expect at most a mechanical conflict there. No open PR touches `last-admin-guard.ts`, `admin-standing-surface.ts`, `sys-user.object.ts` or the route ledger.
- The bucket-count prose at the top of the dogfood sweep (`objectstack-gate` (11 routes)) was already stale before this change (12 entries) and now reads 13. It was left alone as prose outside this diff's purpose.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gate battery (dispatch-gates --commands, reconciled with --ran)</summary>

Derived at `6b5dd985`: 72 families, 72 run. `--ran` reconciliation with the recorded exit codes: **71 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- 70 commands exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the shallow clone cannot reach its pinned positive-control commit `621a48760`). After that one object was fetched it exited 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: the self-test passes (93 cases), then the scan exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: ten packages outside this diff's build closure have no `dist/`, `@objectstack/studio`, `client-react` and others). **NOT MEASURED** locally, because it needs a full `pnpm build`. It is CI's reading (`Lint & Repo Gates`).

</details>

Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 16 touched ts/mjs files, exit 0.
